response.query: Failure-mode analysis: what automated taxonomy, logged signals (contact impulses, torque limits, timing offsets), and root-cause tests should be standard to diagnose sim-to-real mismatches?
response.answer: Automated taxonomy for sim-to-real mismatches includes logged signals like contact impulses, torque limits, and timing offsets. Root-cause tests involve analyzing discrepancies in these logged signals and using diagnostic tools to identify failures. Standard practices include real-time monitoring and cross-referencing simulation data with actual performance.
